correctness.rationale: The proof fixes all quantifiers and normalizations. For \(q<p\), Borsuk--Ulam forces an antipodal encoder collision. Energy distance is a metric and population energy-score regret is exactly \(\mathcal D^2/2\), giving endpoint regret at least \(\Delta_\mu(R)/8\). The generated-law map is \(L_eL_d\)-Lipschitz in \(W_1\); expanding the score shows regret is \((1+2L_eL_d)\)-Lipschitz in the covariate. Integrating the resulting \(\Delta_\mu(R)/16\) floor over the exact spherical cap proves the displayed bound. The translation identity gives \(0<\Delta_\mu(R)\le4R\), and the noiseless specialization gives \(\Delta_\mu(R)=4R\).

value.rationale: The theorem resolves a concrete tension in current generative SDR: measurable one-coordinate sufficiency can coexist with a nonvanishing population proper-score penalty for every bounded-Lipschitz subambient architecture. The explicit dependence on \(p\), \(R\), the translation separation \(\Delta_\mu(R)\), and \(L_eL_d\) makes the result usable as a structural diagnostic and yields a necessary Lipschitz blow-up rate for attempts to approximate pathological measurable reductions.
